fusions.name: Seed Burst
fusions.desc: Spits a seed that deals 8 damage and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Each cast costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Bog Bloom
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of spores ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Lily Patch
fusions.desc: Raises a growth where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Taproot
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 10%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.
